blindSummary: In May 2018, in a town of this state/province, two men were discovered by their community; one was lynched to death and the other escaped. Coverage framed the killing around the local concept of an 'abominable act' defying 'the traditional laws and heritage of the land' — customary authority operating as a moral-jurisdiction mechanism outside the religious-law bloc. No prosecution or accountability is recorded for the killing. The dossier places this state/province among the regions outside that bloc where violent community justice substitutes for formal enforcement: the most lethal documented incident outside the religious-law bloc and the federal capital, met with full impunity.
